metadata.description: LoomaScale MCP for Cursor: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4, GTM, Search Console and Merchant Center, with public competitor ad research.

plugins.name: loomascale
plugins.description: Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads MCP for Cursor. Audit spend, compare video ads, approve campaign changes and research competitors' Google and Meta ads.

plugins.name: loomascale-meta
plugins.description: Meta Ads MCP for Cursor: audit Facebook and Instagram ad spend, delivery and creatives, research the Ad Library and change campaigns on request.

plugins.name: loomascale-tiktok
plugins.description: TikTok Ads MCP for Cursor: audit spend, video creatives and audiences, diagnose delivery and ad review, and preview budget or bid changes.

plugins.name: loomascale-keywords
plugins.description: Google Ads Keyword Planner MCP for Cursor: keyword ideas, search volume, bid ranges, campaign forecasts and ad group fit. Read-only.

plugins.name: loomascale-ga4
plugins.description: Google Analytics 4 MCP for Cursor: analyze traffic, conversions, revenue and funnels. Change key events and stream settings after a dry run and approval.

plugins.name: loomascale-gtm
plugins.description: Google Tag Manager (GTM) MCP for Cursor: audit conversion tracking, draft workspace fixes and publish only the container version you confirm.

plugins.name: loomascale-gsc
plugins.description: Google Search Console MCP for Cursor: analyze SEO traffic, keywords and CTR, inspect URL indexing and submit sitemaps on request.

plugins.name: loomascale-gmc
plugins.description: Google Merchant Center MCP for Cursor: diagnose disapprovals and feed errors, review Shopping performance and update eligible product data on request.
